findings.title: Calls a nonexistent no-argument method
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but its superclass only declares `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)`, and no no-argument overload exists in the hierarchy. This makes the changed source fail to compile and blocks the build.

findings.title: Disables conditional passkeys for anonymous login
findings.body: This helper returns false whenever no user is already selected. On a fresh login, the authentication context normally has no user, so the calls that use this helper do not populate the form with WebAuthn conditional-UI options. As a result, users cannot discover and sign in with passkeys on the normal login page; the same condition also omits those options after errors before a user is identified.
